label: E → diffusion-fick
detail: Explicit FTCS reproduces the analytic Gaussian spread; conserved mass; and ⟨r²⟩ = 4Dt.

label: G → spatial-ipd-nowak-may
detail: Spatial lattice enables cooperation to persist for mild temptation b; well-mixed matching drives defection.

label: H → tilman-chemostat
detail: In a chemostat the species with the lowest break-even resource R* competitively excludes the rival; equal R* yields coexistence.

label: I → vicsek-coordination
detail: Local alignment generates a polarised flock that can collectively navigate toward a goal.

label: J → stochastic-search-composite
detail: Coupling agents to an autogenic field generates spatial coherence and measurable agent–field cross-correlation.
